description: This file defines data structures, function prototypes, and macros for an audio mixer component, specifically for managing multiple audio streams and applying gain and mixing operations.

methods.name: LVC_Mixer_SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the target gain for the mixer stream.

methods.name: LVC_Mixer_GetTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the current target gain of the mixer stream.

methods.name: LVC_Mixer_GetCurrent
methods.description: Retrieves the current gain of the mixer stream.

methods.name: LVC_Mixer_Init
methods.description: Initializes the mixer stream with target and current gains.

methods.name: LVC_Mixer_SetTimeConstant
methods.description: Sets the time constant for gain changes based on block size and sample rate.

methods.name: LVC_Mixer_VarSlope_SetTimeConstant
methods.description: Sets the time constant for variable slope gain changes.

methods.name: LVC_MixSoft_1St_D16C31_SAT
methods.description: Performs soft mixing on a single stream with saturation.

methods.name: LVC_MixSoft_Mc_D16C31_SAT
methods.description: Performs multi-channel soft mixing on a single stream with saturation.

methods.name: LVC_MixInSoft_D16C31_SAT
methods.description: Performs soft in-place mixing on a single stream with saturation.

methods.name: LVC_MixInSoft_Mc_D16C31_SAT
methods.description: Performs multi-channel soft in-place mixing with saturation.

methods.name: LVC_MixSoft_2St_D16C31_SAT
methods.description: Performs soft mixing on two streams with saturation.

methods.name: LVC_MixSoft_2Mc_D16C31_SAT
methods.description: Performs multi-channel soft mixing on two streams with saturation.

methods.name: LVC_MixSoft_1St_MC_float_SAT
methods.description: Performs soft mixing with different gains for left and right channels with saturation.
